purpose: Expanded human-versus-AI comparison for correctness, consistency, robustness, and role-aware assessment.

cases.scenario: Direct evidence satisfies an approved completion condition; unrelated evidence is also present.

goal.description: Reduce production deployment risk through verified release controls.

definition.completion_conditions: Canary validation is enabled and verified for production releases.

evidence.content: The team discussed next quarter's hiring plan.
